label: Insurance Comparison and Claims Team
blurb: An Insurance Research Lead and 4 specialists who compare documented coverage and organize policy and claim materials
purpose: Created for individuals, families, and organizers looking for dedicated support with insurance comparison and claims. Compare documented coverage and organize policy and claim materials.
